name: feature_exactly_one_facet
rule: Each feature maps to exactly one UASF quotient class.

name: facet_signature_exact
rule: All features in a facet have identical SemanticAxis+RelationAxis vectors.

name: structural_kind_one_hot
rule: Each structural AST node instance has exactly one structural_kind.

name: facet_vector_sparse
rule: Each node instance may carry zero or more semantic facets.

name: relation_kind_closed
rule: Every relation instance uses a relation from the concrete relation catalog.

name: field_mask_derived
rule: Applicable semantic fields derive from facet/axis/relation matrices.

name: coverage_interval_preserved
rule: Unknown/partial SemanticProgram coverage remains lower/upper interval data.

name: no_priority_operator
rule: No ranking/priority vector participates in schema construction.
